Folder: /BP/TS-59 Box Module - Overview
Labels: ppm-e2e-cloud, teamboxes

   Data: boxName: TC-3035 Main Box
   Expected: Overview module loads and the boxes are displayed in the folLowing order:
- Bishop
- Knight
- Pawn
- Queen
- Rook

   Expected: "Manual" option is selected. 
"Direction" area disappears.

- Knight
- Bishop
- Pawn
- Queen
